name: Oxyfuel combustion in cement kilns
principle: The kiln burns fuel in oxygen instead of air, and part of the exhaust is recirculated to control temperature. Without nitrogen, the exhaust is 70% CO2 or more, so it only needs purification and compression rather than a separation process.

process_steps.name: Kiln and calciner firing in O2 with flue gas recirculation

suppliers.name: European Cement Research Academy (ECRA) with Heidelberg Materials and Holcim

reference_plants.name: catch4climate pure oxyfuel plant (CI4C), Mergelstetten cement plant
reference_plants.capacity: 450 t/day clinker; designed by thyssenkrupp Polysius; over EUR 120 million, no public funding
reference_plants.status: inaugurated 8 July 2026; first clinker end of May 2026, first oxygen mid-June 2026

reference_plants.name: Colleferro (IT) and Retznei (AT) industrial-scale test conversions
reference_plants.capacity: industrial scale; test phase about EUR 80 million
reference_plants.status: planned March 2018; the conversions did not go ahead — Heidelberg Materials' current CCUS project list and ECRA's CCS project pages name neither plant (both read 28 October 2026), and the industrial-scale oxyfuel demonstration instead proceeded via the catch4climate new-build plant at Mergelstetten, inaugurated 8 July 2026 as the world's first industrial-scale pure oxyfuel facility

source.note: Heidelberg Materials page, 15 Mar 2018, unchanged since (read 28 October 2026); current project lists at heidelbergmaterials.com/en/ccus and ecra-online.org/research/ccs (read 28 October 2026); 'world's first' claim from CI4C partners press release, 8 July 2026

advantages: Can be combined with other capture routes
limitations: Air ingress must be minimised; kiln modifications needed

sources.note: Heidelberg Materials CCUS pages: current carbon capture project list (Brevik, Antoing OxyCal hybrid, Airvault and others) names no Colleferro or Retznei project (read 28 October 2026)

ECRA CCS project page: Phases I-IV.B completed with major focus on oxyfuel and the possibility of initiating an industrial-scale oxyfuel kiln; neither Colleferro nor Retznei listed as projects (read 28 October 2026)
CI4C partners press release, 8 July 2026: world's first industrial-scale pure oxyfuel facility inaugurated at Mergelstetten
